relevance_rank_note: Repeats the ApoE3-vs-ApoE4 surface biotinylation assay in primary neurons and shows genetic NHE6 (Slc9a6) deletion removes the ApoE4-induced loss of receptor surface expression; the rest of the paper is plaque load and synaptic plasticity, which does not bear on receptor recycling.

description: In wildtype (Slc9a6+) primary neurons treated with Reelin, ApoE4-conditioned medium reduced Apoer2 surface/total levels far more than ApoE3, and in Slc9a6- (NHE6 knockout) littermate neurons the ApoE4-induced reduction was gone, so genetic loss of NHE6 fully reverses the ApoE4 recycling block. Effect is ApoE4 vs ApoE3 read off the Slc9a6+ bars; the stars compare with the no-ApoE control, and ApoE4 vs ApoE3 is not tested.
quote: Apoer2 recycling was completely restored in Slc9a6- neurons treated with ApoE4 (Figure 4C).
summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4) -> (less surface Apoer2); (ApoE4 + NHE6 knockout) -> (surface Apoer2 restored to control)
system: Primary cortical neurons from wildtype (Slc9a6+) and germline NHE6-knockout (Slc9a6-) mouse littermate embryos, E18, DIV10-14; 30 min 5 ug/ml HEK293-secreted human ApoE3 or ApoE4 conditioned medium, then 2 ug/ml Reelin 30 min; cell surface biotinylation, surface/total Apoer2 immunoblot. Mouse primary cortical neurons in vitro with exogenous human ApoE and a knockout gene background.
human_check: eff is the Slc9a6+ ApoE4 bar (~27) against the Slc9a6+ ApoE3 bar (~77) in Fig 4C; the authors print no percentage. The only bracket runs from the Slc9a6+ control bar to the ApoE4 bar (***); no ApoE3-ApoE4 bracket, so P is not shown (N/A). Changed from ~73% / <0.005 (vs no-ApoE control) at the team leader's approval, 2026-11-19 referee pass. Class 1 -> 3 (team leader, 2026-11-21): the assay triggers receptor internalisation with Reelin and then reads surface/total once, so it measures surface level (B'), not the recycling step itself.

description: In wildtype (Slc9a6+) neurons treated with Reelin, ApoE4-conditioned medium reduced surface GluN2B more than ApoE3, and NHE6 knockout restored it to control levels. Effect is ApoE4 vs ApoE3 read off the bars; ApoE4 vs ApoE3 is not tested.
quote: In addition, genetic loss of NHE6 equally restored the ApoE4-impaired surface expression of AMPA and NMDA receptor subunits (Figure 4D–F).
summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4) -> (less surface GluN2B); (ApoE4 + NHE6 knockout) -> (surface GluN2B restored)
